_note: Power zone. Generator -> trunk cable -> per-level junction -> buildings, with transmission loss scaling by distance. Junctions have capacity caps, so a well-supplied Shaft can still starve a level.

buildings.name: Main generator
buildings._note: Single point of failure by design. The precision component in its repair cost is what makes a generator fault a multi-day crisis rather than an afternoon's work.

buildings.name: Battery bank
buildings._note: Holds `buffer.add` kW-ticks. Cabled to junctions, it charges from the grid's surplus and, when the generators fall short, keeps THOSE junctions lit and no others. Buys minutes, not hours — enough to get the priority ladder to do its job in an orderly way.

buildings.name: Junction
buildings._note: Lights every room within serviceRadiusLevels of it, up to its network.capacity in kW, once it is cabled back to a generator or a battery. The player ranks junctions 1-5; in a shortfall the grid serves them in that order.
